create_fasttext_lid: create a FastTextLID instance to predict document languages using top-k results
build_ft176_lid: build an FT176LID instance with the 176-language fasttext model for language identification
create_glotlid: create a GlotLID instance with a specific version for language identification
test_lid_predict: test the LID predict method on a Document to return best language and scores
review_fasttext_model: review the FastTextLID model property that lazily loads and caches the fasttext model
